newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador places $120 mln in bonds - ministry source.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador places $120 mln in bonds - ministry source.

text.p: The government of Ecuador placed $120 million of bonds on Thursday to refinance domestic debt and cancel obligations with the creditor nations of the Paris Club, a Finance Ministry official said.
"The issue was very good, and there was an acceptable participation by foreign investors," said the official, who asked not to be named. "This shows that there is confidence."
The bonds were placed on the local stock exchange in a three-year tranche of $70 million and another five-year tranche of $50 million, at 8.91 percent and 9.68 percent respectively.
The paper is part of a total $250 million program to restructure domestic debt and partially repay principal Paris Club debt, which totals $1.2 billion..
Ecuador recently carried out a Brady bond buyback with the income from a $500 million Eurobond issue, the country's first such issue.
